purpose: Competitor models benchmarked on rhj_fewshot. Code and configs only -- they read OUR data in place via competitors/shared/occam_data.py; no competitor dataset is copied.

scoring.their_cell_eval_not_used: 0.7.2 / pdex 0.2.2-0.3.0, with a [0,14] clip and pearson_edistance + clustering_agreement skipped

spaces.map_to_eval: log1p(expm1(x) * 0.2); exact in exact arithmetic because the per-cell denominator cancels. Measured: bit-exact in float32 when the 10k matrix is derived from the 2k one; agrees to one float32 ULP (4.768e-07) when both are computed independently from counts, which is the real case.
spaces.normalised_on: FULL source gene panel row sum, taken BEFORE the 6,983-gene axis restriction
spaces.train_rationale: their pipelines assume pre-normalised input and all pass target_sum=null, log1p=false; the hooke-tx data arrived already log1p(1e4). Our h5ads are raw counts.
